description: A throwaway database for the demo instance when the repo has no way to make one (its only database is hosted, live or shared; no seed; no Docker compose service): use it instead of stopping, and instead of a copy of real data. action create starts one on 127.0.0.1 outside the repo (Postgres from this machine's install, Docker or PGlite with nothing to install; MySQL from this machine's MySQL or MariaDB, or Docker; SQLite for a SQLite app; for a Supabase repo with Docker running, the whole local Supabase stack from its supabase folder, with auth and the REST API), makes the tables with the repo's own tool pointed only at it (prisma migrate deploy or db push, drizzle-kit push, Supabase migrations, schema.sql), and writes an env file with every database setting the repo reads pointed at it; it answers the tables, their columns and the seed to run. action sql runs SQL (or a .sql file) against that database and no other: your seed. action status lists the tables and row counts. action remove stops it and deletes its files. Tell the developer before create, like any database you make for a demo.

action.description: create: make it; sql: run SQL against it; status: its tables and rows; remove: stop and delete it

engine.description: create: which database (default: what the repo uses)

file.description: sql: a .sql file to run instead of sql

repoDir.description: create: the repo (default: the current directory)

schema.description: create: none to skip making the tables

sql.description: sql: the statements to run (several are fine)

via.description: create: where the database comes from (default auto). Postgres: the local Supabase stack for a Supabase repo when Docker runs, else an installed Postgres, Docker, then PGlite. MySQL: an installed MySQL or MariaDB, then Docker

name: demo_data
title: Make a throwaway database for the demo
